column1: # Upstream bin/ files that Upstream code loads or reads instead of running
# them (task 26 follow-up, found in the hands-on 26.04 VM on 2026-11-13).
# every other name links to its Wrapper in /opt/motanka/bin; these names
# link to Upstream's original file, because the Wrapper is a bash script
# (set -euo pipefail; exec run-upstream) and Python then fails with
# SyntaxError, or reads the Wrapper's text instead of the original.
# Running them by name still goes through the Wrapper on the session PATH.
# Upstream passes a literal "$OMARCHY_PATH/bin/<name>" to a Python loader or
# reader that is not listed here, and when a listed name is not in bin/.
